name: Oggleflint
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Oggleflint leads the trogg tribe in Ragefire Chasm. His pack climbs from lava-filled tunnels toward the surface, where he commands them near the cavern entrance and threatens the Horde capital above.

sections.title: Chieftain of the Deep
sections.body: Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Oggleflint and his troggs climbed from fiery tunnels into Ragefire Chasm. They carved a primitive domain among the molten rock and defend it with brutal force. Troggs have little advanced civilization, and Oggleflint rules his pack through sheer strength.

sections.title: Death to Envoys
sections.body: Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem sent diplomats into the chasm to make peace with the troggs. The troggs turned on them and killed them. Maur Grimtotem, one of the envoys, lies dead in the caverns under Oggleflint’s watch. Near the cavern entrance, the chieftain waits and strikes at outsiders who venture into the dark.

sections.title: The Threat Beneath Orgrimmar
sections.body: Oggleflint’s tribe lives directly beneath Thrall’s capital, a hazard the Horde cannot tolerate. The troggs creep closer to the surface, and their volatile nature threatens to carry them into the Drag and Cleft of Shadow if left undisturbed.

faq.answer: Oggleflint is a powerful trogg chieftain who leads his pack in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar.
Oggleflint waits in Ragefire Chasm’s upper caverns, near the entrance tunnel. His pack holds the tunnels nearest the surface.

faq.q: Why are the troggs in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Troggs naturally dwell deep underground in subterranean volcanic networks. Oggleflint’s pack has climbed from the lava-filled tunnels beneath Orgrimmar toward the surface.

faq.q: Why is Oggleflint hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Troggs are fiercely territorial and violent. As Oggleflint and his followers press toward the surface, they threaten the Horde tunnels and the city above.

faq.q: What is Oggleflint's relationship with the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: Oggleflint’s troggs and the Searing Blade cultists share the chasm, but nothing makes them allies. The troggs hold the tunnels near the entrance, while the cultists work in the deeper chambers.

angles.text: Beneath Thrall’s fortress, Oggleflint’s troggs pose a wild, unpredictable security risk in the heart of Durotar.
As a young orc proving your mettle in the trial of arms, facing the chieftain beneath the Drag tests your martial discipline.
As a warrior, you face a heavy brute who relies on raw muscle and primal rage, not armor or discipline.
